name: Yieldoor
description: Yieldoor is a DeFi yield protocol designed to optimize capital through automated strategies in liquidity management, lending, and leveraged yield. The platform integrates advanced DeFi concepts such as concentrated liquidity, fixed-yield arbitrage, and capital-efficient leverage to cater to both passive and active users. Users can choose from various options, including stable passive returns, active high-yield strategies, or leveraged opportunities for greater upside. Yieldoor provides the necessary tools and infrastructure to enhance earnings without the need for manual position management or trend chasing.
